Package comp3607.group10.telemetry.core

Class EditBurst

java.lang.Object
comp3607.group10.telemetry.core.EditBurst
public class EditBurst extends Object
A group of edits to one class that happened close together. It becomes one EDIT_BURST event, so the log is not flooded with single keystrokes.
Author:
Haeley Parbhoo

  • Method Details

    • accepts

      public boolean accepts(String otherClass, long timestampMillis, long gapMillis)
      Tells whether a new edit belongs to this burst: same class, and soon enough after the last edit.
      Parameters:
      otherClass - the class of the new edit
      timestampMillis - when it happened, in epoch milliseconds
      gapMillis - the longest pause between edits that still belong to one burst
      Returns:
      true if it belongs

    • add

      timestampMillis - when it happened, in epoch milliseconds
